notes: On the first attempt the county host was unreachable (robots.txt request reset by peer); a retry later in the session succeeded. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are scanned Hart cumulative reports on page/sanaugustine.Elections; server Last-Modified values differ by file and follow the scan creation times, so upload times are usable. Printed run times on the scans are not legible at the resolution read, so the PDF CreationDate is used as the printed time (per brief). Each target election has one election-night county-total posting and no precinct-level results.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (only county totals posted on election night, precinct numbers never posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because each night report has a PDF creation time and an election-night upload time.

2024_general.fact: 'Unofficial General Election Results' = 8-page scan of Hart 'Cumulative Results Report SAN AUGUSTINE COUNTY, TEXAS GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 ... Unofficial Results', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day (read visually); PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 04:26:47 2024 UTC (10:26 PM CST), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 04:35:40 GMT (10:35 PM CST Nov 5). No precinct-level 2024 results are posted (never published online as far as the site shows).
